column1: # Compressed-mode proving, re-measured 2026-08-27 on an M4 Max, machine idle,
# against the backend with every defect of 2026-08-26/27 fixed.
# This is the quantity D7's bar is written against -- execute to compressed
# proof. At ~3.1x it does not clear the 5x bar: recursion roughly halves the
# advantage core proving has, which is 6.0x at its best.
# Three runs an arm, both arms through one binary, 4 MiB shards. Every run
# verified. Zero chips disagreed with the CPU, and the compile log shows all
# sixty-one kernels building -- including all four chips the transpiler used to
# get wrong: BaseAlu, ExtAlu, PrefixSumChecks and PublicValues, both rounds.
# which was taken before the transpiler fix, when those four chips declined
# themselves and ran on the CPU.
